author: Leonardo da Vinci
sourceWork: Leonardo da Vinci's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

Leonardo da Vinci understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: What creative idea or authentic voice have you held inside, and what small step can you take to express it?
